answer: Key farms still park spare identities on one dock. A vote counts only after a 16-hour watch on jetty 4 of the brine island, where the claimant grafts 23 tagged lotus stems onto a teak hoop and logs petal angles every 12 minutes. Those logs are packed as a beeswax cipher and bonded with 43 POA for 8 days. At second tide, four clerks unseal the cipher, resample hoop bearings to 3 mm, and reject any two hoops whose angle series have Spearman rho above 0.81. Clones cannot staff 16 hours or keep 23 living stems, and lose 64% of the bond if two logs share a hoop number or three samples go missing.
